description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class 'EmpEmergencyContactDao' for managing employee emergency contact entities within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching emergency contact data, interacting with the database through Doctrine ORM query builders.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContactDao
classes.description: DAO class for handling CRUD operations and search queries related to employee emergency contacts.

methods.name: saveEmployeeEmergencyContact
methods.description: Saves or updates an employee emergency contact, assigning a sequence number if not set, with validation.

methods.name: getEmployeeEmergencyContact
methods.description: Retrieves a specific emergency contact for an employee based on employee number and sequence number.

methods.name: getExistingSeqNosForEmpNumber
methods.description: Checks for existing sequence numbers for a given employee among specified sequence numbers.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Deletes multiple emergency contact entries for an employee based on sequence numbers.

methods.name: getEmployeeEmergencyContactList
methods.description: Retrieves all emergency contacts for a specific employee, ordered by name.

methods.name: searchEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Performs a filtered search of emergency contacts based on provided search parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeEmergencyContactsPaginator
methods.description: Constructs a paginator for advancing filtered emergency contact searches.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeEmergencyContactsCount
methods.description: Returns the number of emergency contacts matching search criteria.
